text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I can't believe I lost! O Shiraoki, why didst thou desert me?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: What if Shiraoki was asleep or something? I can't have a god that's napping on the job!
choice_data_list: Let's do our best next time.
Maybe your skills are being put to the test.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Nngh, okay… It just wasn't my lucky day, I guess. What can you do?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Sigh… I just hope Shiraoki will be awake next time around.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Say what?! Are you suggesting that the great Shiraoki wished to see how I perform without good fortune on my side?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Nooo! Doesn't this mean I've completely messed up?! Shiraoki must be so disappointed!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I need to get back on track! I'm definitely taking first next race… Or, at least second!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With Matikanefukukitaru's feet to the fire, we make a vow to come out victorious next time.
